rules.value: Good luck, have fun, dont die
Each child cost 5% of income, minimun $5,000
You can choose to live at home until you are 25, then you are kicked out
Minum wage jobs are 100% succesful, $5 over minum wage roll 7-12, above that first roll 12 is succesful, next roll 11-12 is succesful ect... and must always have the education
min car cost $5,000, public transit free

events.title: Car crash
events.description: Watch out!. 2-6 = Your car is totaled, add half your cars value to your savings

events.title: Lottory win
events.description: You win the lottory. Add 1,000x your roll to your savings

events.title: In the know
events.description: You have connections to a job, 4-12 = Your hired!. 2-3 = you still dont get the job.

events.title: Oops a baby
events.description: Positive!, 2-6 = Add 1 baby. 7-12 = Choose if you want to keep it

events.title: Cheater!
events.description: Your partner catches you, 2-6 = Devorce. 7-12 = You went to councaling and worked it out

events.title: Job loss
events.description: Your job is doing layoffs, 2-6 = You get layed off, no income this year. 7-12 = You dont get laied off

events.title: Tripped
events.description: You trip over a slightly raised peace of concreat. 2-6 = -75% income this year, your on disablility this year. 7-12 = tis but a scratch
